BC_description: Excess command-arguments now cause an error by default, as 'allowExcessArguments' is set to false by default. Previously, extra arguments were silently accepted. This change affects the 'parse' method of the 'program' object, which is used to parse command-line arguments.
Adaptation_method: To adapt, declare expected arguments using 'program.argument()' or suppress the error with 'program.allowExcessArguments()'. Example: Before: program.parse() without argument declaration. After: program.argument('[args...]', 'description') or program.allowExcessArguments(true).
